name: Tsuboi-san
source:
An eel-like creature living in a vase. According to him, he is a spirit of the vase. His duty is similar to that of a navigator. Loves convenience store sweets. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206508]Getchu[/url]]
